integrity: Claims are analytically proved, reproducible numeric checks are supplementary, and originality remains subject to independent literature assessment.
scientific_limitations: Static memoryless state feedback, fixed radius before thermodynamic network limit, stationary identity noise, exact arithmetic. The optimized excess cost has a sharp asymptotic order but no computed leading constant; other dynamic architectures are excluded.
title: Sharp static LQR locality cost on a nearest-neighbor cyclic network
